title: RFdiffusion All-Atom Input Parameters
description: RFdiffusion All-Atom-specific parameters passed via DesignRequest.toolParams. Ligand- and metal-aware all-atom backbone generation: diffuses protein backbones around small molecules, cofactors, and metal ions. Emits all-atom backbones only; sequences are added by a downstream ProteinMPNN pass (see manifest.composes).

binder_length_range.description: Min/max residue length of the designed binder backbone.

noise_scale.description: Diffusion noise scale at inference time. Lower = more conservative backbones.

contigs.description: Advanced override: full RFdiffusion contigmap.contigs string. When present, overrides target_chain + binder_length_range.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target in the input PDB.

ligand.description: Optional ligand / cofactor / metal to diffuse the backbone around. RFdiffusion All-Atom is ligand- and metal-aware. Supply inline SDF text, an explicit atom list (e.g. metal ions), and/or a CCD code resolved from the target PDB's HETATM records.

sdf.description: Inline SDF/MOL block describing the small molecule or cofactor.

ccd.description: CCD ligand code (e.g. "HEM", "ZN") to pull from the target PDB's HETATM records.

atoms.description: Explicit atom list (e.g. metal ions) as [{element, x, y, z}].

num_designs.description: Backbones per seed. Mirrored at top-level DesignRequest.numDesigns.

skip_mpnn.description: If true, platform will NOT chain ProteinMPNN automatically. Adapter itself always just emits backbones.
